title: Modern MAE2
description: A little texture pack that tries to make some textures from Modern AE2 Additions look like ones from 1.21 AE2.
body:
# _**Modern**_ Modern AE2 Additions
So, this is a little texture pack that I whipped up in about an hour for my mate's request. It tries to make so the textures for blocks from **MODERN AE2 ADDITIONS** now look like the ones seen in AE2 for 1.21.n, or rather, the ones from **PERFECT AE2 RESOURCE BACKPORT**.

**The textures were traced from [RUMI727](https://modrinth.com/user/Rumi727)'s work.** 

Here are the changed textures, in the following order:
1. 4x Crafting Co-Processing Unit
2. 16x Crafting Co-Processing Unit
3. 64x Crafting Co-Processing Unit
4. 256x Crafting Co-Processing Unit
5. Faulty Memory Card

![The aforementioned textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1763f364a500c73353cd1f193855028ecd6ab043.png)
![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d25609a61fec9e87f9c6cd17504449fcb8dab4b.png)

PBR and depth maps pending. Name will probably change. 
### Have fun, i guess.
